# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.112.4.js` is the unmodified UMD bundle from the official npm package `@supabase/supabase-js@2.112.4`. See `SUPABASE-LICENSE`.

SHA-256: `f8ce7fab799af1916019cbd0b485b39bb80dbdbc6dc062909a751c9e5198e04c`.

It is served locally, with no runtime CDN dependency. Account pages load it on demand; anonymous marketing browsing does not need to download it. Updates must be version-pinned, checksum-verified, and tested against the account flows.
